thread:
Riley Gomez: Heads-up Halcyon EAP NDA executed today. CI will provision racks next week. Need to confirm benchmark matrix + marketplace packaging requirements by Fri.

Priya Nair: Congrats. I'll take packaging + marketplace checklist. Can someone own the perf matrix? :raised_hands:

Halcyon Eng: Hi team 
 Provisioning notes: 40GbE RDMA (Broadcom), dual redundant PDUs, custom u-boot v1.3.2. SSH via jump.box.halcyon.net. We'll share rack photos and thermal curves.

Riley Gomez: Thanks. Perf owner = Jordan? Jordan (PM): I can coordinate runs and timelines. Quick Q: do we need KV cache probes or full trace collection?

Priya Nair: Need both. KV cache counters + sampled traces for debugging. Retention: 60 days for traces, 180 days for aggregated metrics.

Halcyon Eng: We can expose metrics on port 9100 and push logs to an SFTP. Will also enable pcap on NIC for first 2 smoke runs.

Riley Gomez: Suggested baseline matrix from infra team:
- model: rwlf-1b / rwlf-3b
- seq: 512, 1024
- batch: 1, 4
- quant: fp16 + 4-bit int8-like
- duration: 30m per config

Jordan (PM): Sounds good. Also include a stability stress run: 6hr continuous seq=1024 batch=2 for p99 tail behavior.

Riley Gomez: Minimal repro command (I'll commit to the runbook):
```
# run bench on host
./redwood-bench --model rwlf-3b --seq 1024 --batch 4 --quant fp16 --time 1800 --emit-metrics /tmp/halcyon_metrics.json
```

build-bot: Note: CI image tag for bench is `bench:v2.5-rc`. Please pin if running reproducible tests. :gear:

Priya Nair: Marketplace packaging checklist items:
- OCI image with entrypoint + license files
- SBOM attached
- minimal sample app + quickstart
- privacy redaction guide for joint announcement

Halcyon Eng: Firmware matrix: base-fw v1.3.2, igb-driver v2.1.0, cuda 12.1 (expected). Will upload CSV to shared drive.

Jordan (PM): Two asks from marketing/legal: (1) redacted non-performance announcement template by pilot midpoint, (2) an internal exec-safe summary with high-level perf bands (no raw numbers) by pilot end.

Riley Gomez: Ops ask: we need an exclusive window for heavy runs. Halcyon, can you guarantee a 3-hr daily exclusive slot for first week? Also confirm noisy-neighbor mitigation.

Halcyon Eng: We can reserve 03:00-06:00 UTC for exclusive runs for the first 7 days. We'll enable SR-IOV isolation on those ports.

Priya Nair: Telemetry endpoints we need:
- /metrics/kv_cache_hits
- /metrics/request_latency_ms (histogram)
- gpu_temp_celsius sampled 5s
- power_draw_watts sampled 10s
Store traces at sftp://halcyon-eap/redwood/{run_ts}.tgz

build-bot: Reminder: set artifact retention for sftp uploads = 90d (requested by Priya Nair). :robot_face:

Jordan (PM): Action items recap:
- Riley -> finalize runbook + commit repro commands
- Priya -> marketplace packaging + SBOM
- Halcyon Eng -> upload firmware matrix, rack photos, confirm exclusive window
- Jordan -> coordinate legal/marketing templates
I'll post a kickoff checklist doc in the channel after lunch. ETA first baseline run Wed night.

Riley Gomez: Great. If network or firmware blocks appear, DM me. :thumbsup:
